I have grown beans on this plot since I was a young girl, and I know what works here. I will spread manure from my cows because it makes the soil soft and the beans grow well, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer because it costs too much and beans do not need it the way maize does. I will plant the same seeds I kept from last harvest because they have always done fine, and I do not trust those new seeds the sellers in town talk about. My children and grandchildren will help with the digging, weeding, and harvesting, so I do not need to hire anyone from outside.
